basis: THE main reels to recreate (user, 2026-11-23). Picked from the 93 clips in docs/reel-refs/clip-study and the 913-post scout sweep (docs/reel-refs/scout/SCOUT.md), weighed against the lessons in docs/REEL_RESULTS.md (lock or push-ups in the first frame, sends need a line about someone else, installs over reach).

formats.name: Caught doing the task
formats.short: Creator account films their own morning task: groggy, annoyed, doing it anyway.
formats.evidence: Strongest evidence in the whole set. Wayk and Erly creator accounts with a few thousand followers hit 34.3M, 28.6M, 15.8M, 11.3M, 9.4M, 6.1M. Same creator's calm version got 1.6K: it's a lottery, so volume matters.
formats.locturne: A '…wakesup' style account. Phone propped on the floor at 7am, you doing the push-ups or the dance while half asleep. Caption: "my apps won't open until I do 20 push-ups 😭". End on TikTok opening. Locturne named in caption + pinned comment.
beats: Groggy in bed, alarm / shield on screen
Get up, do the push-ups or dance on camera
formats.fit: Push-ups + dance cameras already exist. This is the Erly shape your notes call best-evidenced.

clips.note: dancer, "my alarm said GET UP and meant it"
"can't scroll in bed anymore": closest angle to Locturne

formats.name: Witness POV
formats.short: Someone else films you: partner, roommate, mum. They're the narrator.
formats.evidence: Wayk "just found out the hard way how she wakes up" 4.6M; @grindlocker0 "he says it's annoying but it works" 450K. A third person makes it feel caught, not staged.
formats.locturne: Roommate films you doing push-ups on the floor at 6:58 in the dark. Caption: "he's not allowed TikTok until he gets out of bed". This is the line about someone else your results say sends need, and this time the reel actually shows him.
beats: Camera person whispers / caption sets the rule
Phone shows the app finally open
formats.fit: Fixes the car-9 lesson: a third-person line only gets sends when the reel shows the person.

clips.note: partner films from bed, then setup screens

formats.name: Crashing out + the counter
formats.short: Dark bedroom, Snapchat-style caption, then a screen recording of the rep counter to the win screen.
formats.evidence: Wayk "crashing out" caught-at-night 3.2M; PushClock in bed + rep counter 137K on an app account. Closest existing thing to your push-up camera.
formats.locturne: Groggy face → lock screen 6:58 with the shield → screen recording of the push-up camera with Loc yelling the count → moonrise + Loc's yell. Copy PushClock's beat order exactly, your camera screen is the better version of theirs.
beats: Face + caption "crashing out bc my apps won't open until…"
formats.fit: Lock in the first second, no face-then-demo cliff if the shield is in frame from the start.

clips.note: dark bedroom, flop out of bed

formats.name: "No push-ups, no scroll" rule
formats.short: 10–18 s: the rule on screen, a rep set, the app opens. Built to be sent.
formats.evidence: @the.pushupperson 9.6M ("share this with someone who needs it"), 1.4M; @skyirezumi 344K. Account median is ~1.7K, so again volume.
formats.locturne: "My phone won't let me open TikTok until I do 20 push-ups". One rep set with Loc counting, TikTok opens. Caption ends "send this to someone who needs it".
beats: Rule as text over the shield
formats.fit: Shortest format here; fits the 12–15 s install-focused cut you're testing.

clips.note: 10 s, "share with someone who needs it"
says what the app does in one line

formats.name: Day N series → the recap
formats.short: "Day 1 of …" daily posts; the long-run recap is the real hit.
formats.evidence: @jay.coull Day 1 39.3M (days 2–4: 5.5M/3.6M/1.5M); @365ili Day 719 recap 38.2M on a 2K-median account; @ellysejay "Day 232 of reclaiming my time" 1.7M. Counter-evidence: many day-N serials die at under 200 views.
formats.locturne: "Morning 1 of my apps sleeping until I get out of bed." Film the shield + the method each day; the in-app Morning N count is the label. Recap at 30 and 100 with a grid of the week dots / moons.
formats.fit: Matches the face account's Day-N role. Your never-reset morning count is made for it.

formats.name: Three people, one challenge
formats.short: Ensemble comparison: same rule, different people, who did best.
formats.evidence: @Browney "3 guys do 200 push-ups a day for 30 days" 15.8M, pull-ups version 10.5M. Long YouTube, but the premise works as a Short.
formats.locturne: Three friends, three wake methods (push-ups, dance, walk), same 7am lock. "Who gets TikTok back first?" Split screen, timer, winner. Also works as "3 roommates, 1 week of Locturne".
formats.fit: Uses the method grid, built-in competition, people tag friends.

formats.name: "Did y'all know…" discovery
formats.short: Shocked face or text: a hidden feature people didn't know existed.
formats.evidence: The autoscroll wave: @thestarrdestiny 9.5M (in bed, in the dark), @grifftomaino 2.9M, @tsltempo 828K with 94K shares (text over gameplay). Discovery posts get shared.
formats.locturne: "Did y'all know your iPhone can put your apps to sleep until you get out of bed??" Keep the shield on screen from frame one (tsltempo's text-over-footage layout) so there's no face→demo cut.
beats: "did y'all know…" text over the shield
Show the walk / push-ups wake it
formats.fit: Screen Time lock is something most people don't know an app can do. That's the surprise.

clips.note: face in bed, "TikTok has auto scroll"

formats.name: 3am relatable text
formats.short: One line of text over a dark bed scene. No talking.
formats.evidence: @nobodysausage "me scrolling dance videos at 3am" 22.3M; @princessmilyy "nightly doom scroll" 2.3M; @lajiq8 "sacrificing sleep for free time" 2M; @happydadloves 6 s 9.7M. The top of the scout list is almost all this.
formats.locturne: Loc account: "me at 3am: one more video" over a dark bed shot, then the shield drops: "Shh. I'm sleeping. So are they." The punchline is the lock, so the reveal is the demo.
formats.fit: Loc's role on the three-account split. Cheap to make in volume.

formats.name: Screen-time reaction
formats.short: React to someone's screen time number, or confess your own.
formats.evidence: @uncltrd "18 hours in Crossy Road" 7.7M; @mrleeo9 "me with 12h of screen time when I see kids on phones" 5.3M; @dmntrahloww reacting to viewers' screen times 2M.
formats.locturne: "Send me your screen time, Loc rates it." React to followers' screenshots, then show yours with the night block. Comments become the next video's material.
formats.fit: Gives people something to comment, the gap your results flagged (0 comments on describe-the-app captions).

formats.name: The big number
formats.evidence: Opal "15 years looking down at your phone" 4.4M, reposted for 1.8M more; BePresent "534,323 parents…" 1.4M.
formats.locturne: Use your onboarding reveal: "You'll spend 2 years of your life in bed on your phone" with the one-square-per-week grid filling. Last 2 s: the shield.
beats: Shield: what you can do about it
formats.fit: You already built the reveal screen; it's a ready-made visual.

left_out: Storytime talking head (unrot 4.2M) and face-hook skits: your own posts lost 19–27 pts at the face→demo cut four times. Produced montage (BePresent 7.7M): one-off, expensive. Founder story / big-creator sponsor: low views or paid.
